facts.text: The New York Times published a famous retraction titled "A Correction" on July 17, 1969, admitting that its earlier 1920 article had incorrectly stated that rocket pioneer Robert H. Goddard did not understand the need for a better-than-vacuum reaction medium. The Times apologized for the error after the Apollo 11 launch proved that rockets can function in a vacuum.

facts.text: Police from Edgartown, Massachusetts came to the scene of an automobile accident on Chappaquiddick Island and found the body of 27-year old secretary Mary Jo Kopechne inside an Oldsmobile 88 automobile that had fallen into a deep pond.
